sample_unit: cropped tooth images from panoramic radiographs

links.outcome: Agreement and accuracy of general-purpose LLMs versus expert for root resorption severity on radiographs
links.effect: GPT-4o kappa 0.371 (binary), accuracy 36.5%, MAE 1.269; Gemini kappa -0.152, accuracy 13.5%, MAE 1.750; both poor for moderate to severe EARR.
links.quote: Nevertheless, both models showed limited accuracy and agreement, particularly in detecting moderate to severe resorption, and neither can be considered suitable for clinical application at this stage.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of multimodal foundation models (GPT-4o and Gemini 2 Flash) on cropped dental radiographs against expert ratings without evaluating a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
